message:
The other day, we were packing our go-bags for a weekend camping trip. In our excitement, we crammed in all the essentials—snacks, flashlights, and even a couple of extra layers. But then, when we reached for our important documents, we realized they were still sitting on the kitchen counter, right next to the takeout menus! 🤦‍♂️ 

It was a comedic reminder that preparedness isn’t just about the gear; it’s also about having everything in one place. So, we learned to create a little checklist and keep our documents in a designated spot. 

What’s your favorite trick for staying organized when it comes to readiness?
